content:
Priya: heads-up — finance asked for a winter-surge GPU-hour forecast, they want p95/p99 safety margins included. can we get a quick sketch?
Diego: +1. We should account for EU/East-asia launch + spot preemption risk. target p99 latency is 300ms for text-gen endpoints.
Marta: current baseline: 120 active GPUs (A100 80GB equiv), avg throughput 18 reqs/s per GPU, median seq len 128, mix ~60% chat, 40% completion.
Priya: so if p99 spikes double median reqs/s during peak, what's headroom?
Diego: rough first-pass: assume peak R = baseline_R * 2. Baseline R = 120 * 18 = 2160 reqs/s. Peak R ~= 4320 reqs/s. If we want target util <= 65% at p99, required_gpus = ceil(4320 / (18 * 0.65)) = ceil(4320 / 11.7) ~= 370 GPUs.
Marta: that jives with our seasonal multiplier. add 10% safety for node churn and cross-region failover -> ~407 GPUs.
Priya: can we avoid full reserve by admission control? want SLO-preserving throttling policy that prefers cached/short calls.
Diego: yes — two levers: (1) soft-cap backlog threshold per shard (queue_len > Q -> reject or downgrade), (2) token-aware admission: favor requests with predicted token budget < T.
Marta: propose thresholds: Q=400 total queued requests across region, T=256 tokens. Also fast-fail for >10s queue time.
Jon: quick thought on cost: incremental GPUs ~280 more (370-120). At $2.4/hr reserved equivalent -> 280 * 2.4 * 24 * 30 ~= $484k/month. If we use 40% spot for burst, add preempt buffer of +30 GPUs warm spare.
Priya: yikes. need to show tradeoffs: reserved vs burst vs admission. put that in the ask to finance.
SRE-Bot: reminder: last night eu-west rolling reboot succeeded, reported 2% node churn during maintenance window. will factor into availability budget.
Diego: also consider model quantization steps — 8-bit runs ~1.6x throughput. If safe quality-wise, that reduces required GPUs to ~250 at peak (before safety add-ons).
Marta: final suggested plan for the doc to finance: (1) baseline + surge math (include the calc above), (2) three procurement options: full reserved, mixed reserved+spot, soft-cap + horizontal burst, (3) SLO-preserving admission policy specs (queue and token thresholds), (4) cost sensitivity with quantization.
Priya: can someone draft the short spreadsheet and a one-pager? Diego/Marta?
Diego: I'll start a tiny spreadsheet and drop in #eng-sre-reporting. will include the formula and scenario rows.
Marta: I'll draft the admission-control pseudocode and a few sims (p95/p99 lake) — will need help running small queue sim.
Jon: I can run a 12-hour synthetic replay on staging to estimate real q99 behaviour with the soft-cap. schedule it after Diego's spreadsheet.
Priya: perfect. try to have draft to show finance by EOD Friday. thanks. :thumbsup:
Diego: copying the quick formula here for the doc:```
# rough GPU count math
peak_rate = baseline_rate * surge_multiplier
throughput_per_gpu = base_throughput * quantization_speedup
required_gpus = ceil( peak_rate / (throughput_per_gpu * target_util) )
```
Marta: and an example sensitivity row to include: no-quant / 8-bit quant / +10% demand / +30% churn.
SRE-Bot: incident note pinned: "eu-west maintenance — 2% churn"
Priya: nice, keep replies short in the doc. we'll iterate.
Diego: will upload spreadsheet + short slides in #eng-sre-reporting and link here when ready.
Marta: uploaded sim results link: https://internal/redwood/sims/winter-surge-186900 — sample p99 numbers attached (see spreadsheet).
Priya: got it, will pull numbers and finalize the ask. cheers."
